phaseSemantics.prepared: labor committed at camp, NOT yet departed — physically AT HOME
phaseSemantics.outbound: physically walking toward the target — physically AWAY
phaseSemantics.note: isExpeditionAway() includes `prepared` for LABOR commitment. For PHYSICAL presence, prepared is still at the residence; this audit separates the two.

ghostResidencePopulation.note: buildCrowdingField weights the home scatter by demography.population (FULL). Anyone physically away is projected at home too.

missingAwayPresence.decisiveMeasurementNote: Only `beyondResidenceBall*` is decisive. Inside the radius-4 ball the residence's own scatter already covers the tile, so 'presence' there says nothing about the party.

sameDayPartyInvisibility.note0: deduplicated by (band, day, target); the bounded recentIntraSeasonTrips ring is re-read every band-season and must not be counted repeatedly
sameDayPartyInvisibility.note: no reference to recentIntraSeasonTrips exists in crowding.ts or sharedCatchment.ts; a same-day party is physically invisible to shared-range

catchmentOverlap.note: getBandForagingDraw reads demography.workingAdults, NOT getResidentialWorkingAdults. Reported as an accounting observation, not yet as a defect.

socialConsequences.note: no encounter or friction authority reads expedition party position or trip records; parties create no social consequence at all
